character.description: One young Saudi man, seen only from behind walking away and exiting frame-right through the majlis doorway; face never clearly shown
character.appearance: Medium-brown skin tone, upright confident posture, unhurried walk, face not visible to camera
character.hair: Short black hair with a tight fade at the nape, mostly covered by a white ghutra
character.grooming: Clean, neat trimmed beard line along the jaw visible only in faint side profile
character.build: Slim athletic build, medium height, straight shoulders
wardrobe: Crisp creamy-white full-length Saudi thobe with a mandarin collar and plain buttoned cuffs
White ghutra folded neatly on the head, held by a black agal
Brown leather sandals or closed formal slip-on shoes
Slim dark-brown leather watch strap on the left wrist

product.name: the fragrance
product.form: Rectangular faceted glass bottle with thick beveled base, chamfered shoulders and a heavy squared cap, about hand-sized
product.materials: Thick transparent amber-tinted faceted glass with polished edges, brushed-gold metal cap, glossy liquid inside
product.colors: Deep amber glass, warm honey liquid, brushed-gold cap
product.branding_style: Completely wordless: no label, logo or printed text, only a plain smooth glass front panel and an unmarked gold collar
distinctive_features: Sharp light-catching facets along the glass edges
Heavy brushed-gold cap with a clean flat top
Thick glass base that glows amber when backlit
product.hero_angle: Close eye-level three-quarter view on the carved wooden side table, key light from camera-left grazing the facets, bottle upright and centered in the upper-middle of the frame

color_grade.contrast: Medium-high contrast with deep brown shadows that keep detail and soft amber highlights that never clip
color_grade.saturation: Moderately saturated warm tones, restrained and rich, no strong cool colours except the faint cool spill at the doorway
color_grade.film_emulation: Warm 35mm cinema film stock look with fine grain, soft highlight roll-off

location.primary: Refined traditional Najdi majlis with floor cushions, an armchair, a carved wooden side table, woven sadu textiles, a sand-toned patterned carpet and sand-colored walls, with a tall window camera-left and the doorway at frame-right
secondary: Corner of the majlis with a wooden wall peg holding the ghutra, a brass dallah and small cup on a low tray
Window and doorway area with a sheer curtain, patterned carpet and a faint trail of oud smoke

output.mood: Quiet, elegant, anticipatory, with a lingering presence after someone has left; ends in luxurious, confident stillness
output.lighting: Golden-hour baseline: warm 3000-3200K sunlight from a tall window at camera-left casting long diagonal shadows, warm bounce from sand-colored walls, faint dust motes and steam catching amber rim light; the only deliberate deviation is the subtle cool 5600K spill from the open doorway at frame-right in the curtain scene
output.audio_mood: Soft ambient room tone with a faint breath of wind, gentle oud and low warm cello pad, subtle fabric rustle and a quiet glass chime on the final bottle shot, no dialogue
forbidden: No readable text, lettering, logos or captions anywhere in the footage, including on the bottle
No short sleeves, shorts or revealing clothing on the man
No clear view of the man's face
Door always at frame-right, never flip screen direction
No modern gadgets or bright neon or cool blue lighting
No changes to bottle shape, glass colour or cap between shots
